drafter.private_reasoning: Remove internal comments and other potentially confidential drafting artifacts before circulation. Strengthen the mutual NDA with a clear use restriction, customary exceptions, representative safeguards, and express survival. Do not introduce transaction economics into the NDA.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our proposed mutual NDA revisions. We have clarified permitted use and disclosures, added customary confidentiality exclusions and return provisions, and aligned the confidentiality obligations with the agreement’s term. These changes are intended to facilitate the parties’ exchange of diligence materials. Please let us know if you have any comments.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of either party to the other in connection with the Purpose, in any form, including analyses derived from that information and the existence, status, and terms of discussions. Confidential Information excludes information that the receiving party can demonstrate is publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement, was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY AND USE. Each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it using at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality duties at least as protective as those in this Agreement. The receiving party is responsible for their compliance. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving party may disclose only the portion legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall provide prompt advance notice and reasonable cooperation, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except that legally required archival copies and routine backup copies may be retained subject to this Agreement. No intellectual property rights are granted by disclosure.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The confidentiality and use obligations for each disclosure survive for three years following that disclosure; for information constituting a trade secret, those obligations continue for as long as it remains a trade secret under applicable law. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or enter into a transaction. Any transaction requires a separately executed definitive agreement.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to any other available remedies.

Clarify that certification is by an authorized representative and identifies permitted retention, and that disaster-recovery restoration does not permit substantive use. No confidential transaction economics are included.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have accepted the five-year survival period measured from the later of termination or the relevant disclosure, with continuing trade-secret protection. We have also added written certification upon request and continuing protection and access restrictions for retained archival and backup copies. The revised language clarifies how permitted retention and disaster-recovery restoration are handled. Subject to your confirmation, we believe the NDA is ready for signature.
